cases.text:
Northing: 8; easting: 5.
The stake reads 8 north and 5 east.
On the plot, 8/5 marks the marker.

The lantern gives the stair its light.
After giving away the suitcase, I walk light.
At the closed ward door, I ask for light.

The cedar keeps the snow.

[Close the next three stanzas with the opening line; those stanzas are not included.]
Rain darkens an abandoned glove beside the kiosk; a gull tilts beyond warehouses while tin roofs cool beneath noon.
